'''Timak''' is a lord of [[the Blood]] and serves in the [[Ever Victorious Army]].
== Activities ==
He is part of the ''[[Hailene]]'', and aids in the occupation of [[Toman Head]]. He is the commanding officer in the village of [[Tobin's Hollow]], which sits close to the border with [[Almoth Plain]]. He commands a ''[[sul'dam]]'' named [[Serrah]].<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
